meta_description: Adams Garden Care in Southampton. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local family gardener. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to year-round maintenance, Adams Garden Care transforms Southampton gardens into spaces you'll love to spend time in.
services_heading: Complete Garden Care Services in Southampton
services_subhead: Whether you need a one-off tidy or ongoing maintenance, we handle everything from hedge cutting to full garden transformations.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting, edging, and weed control. We keep your lawn looking neat and healthy year-round, plus seasonal scarifying and aeration.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional hedge cutting, shaping, and removal. Safe tree pruning and felling with full waste removal. We work to local planning guidelines.

services.title: Border Clearance & Planting
services.desc: Overgrown beds cleared and replanted with new perennials, shrubs, or seasonal flowers. We design borders that thrive with minimal fuss.

services.title: Patio & Path Cleaning
services.desc: Pressure washing and gentle cleaning to remove algae, moss, and dirt. We restore patios, driveways, and paths without damaging delicate surfaces.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Full garden redesigns, new beds, raised planters, and hardscaping. We create practical, beautiful outdoor spaces that suit your lifestyle.

services.title: Seasonal & Spring Clean Services
services.desc: Autumn leaf clearance, spring deep cleans, and winter preparation. Keep your garden looking fresh whatever the season.

about_pullquote: I believe a good garden should work for you, not stress you out.
about_para_1: Adams Garden Care was founded over 15 years ago by a lifelong gardening enthusiast who wanted to bring real expertise and genuine care to Southampton's gardens. What started as one man with a mower has grown into a trusted local team known for reliability, attention to detail, and fair pricing. We've maintained everything from small urban balconies to large country properties.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us season after season because we listen to what you actually want, not just what we think gardens should look like. We're proud that over 90% of our work comes from repeat clients and personal referrals — a testament to the relationships we build with every garden we touch.

reviews.text: Our garden was an absolute jungle when we called. Adams came round, gave us a fair quote, and spent two full days clearing, replanting, and tidying. It looks like a proper garden now. We've had them back every month since. Brilliant work.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using Adams for our lawn maintenance for three years now. Turns up on time, always does a quality job, and isn't trying to upsell you on things you don't need. Honest local gardener. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Called for a free quote on our overgrown borders. Not only did he give solid advice, but the price was reasonable and the work was completed quicker than expected. Garden looks amazing. Would definitely recommend to anyone in Southampton.
reviews.author: James L.
